description: What is opening in this Texas city or ZIP? Returns pre-opening and new-outlet signals since a date, one row per address, each with a stage (applied, licensed, permitted, opened) and its source records. Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Filter by NAICS code or category (restaurant, bar, liquor_store, convenience_store, brewery_winery_distillery). Example: {"city": "Fort Worth", "since": "2026-07-01", "category": "restaurant"}.

category.description: Business category. Ignored when naics is given.

city.description: Texas city, e.g. "Fort Worth". Give a city or a zip.

naics.description: NAICS code or prefix, e.g. "722511" (full-service restaurants).

since.description: Earliest signal date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last two years. Default 90 days ago.

name: find_new_activity
title: New and opening businesses in a Texas area
